content.text: Core database concepts that apply across all relational database systems. These fundamentals form the foundation for working with any SQL database vendor.

items: SQL Fundamentals — Joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, and stored procedures
SQL Performance Tuning — Query plan analysis, indexing strategies, and optimization techniques
Database Design Patterns — Schema design, normalization, denormalization, and data modeling
Transactions and Consistency — ACID properties, isolation levels, and distributed transactions
